gold_note: Theropod cladogram. The numbered circles 1-24 are keys, not names. MANIRAPTORA's box spans exactly one clade (node 7, Ornitholestes to Confuciusornis) and is kept as an internal label; COELUROSAURIA's box covers the Albertosaurus-Tyrannosaurus pair and node 5, which are not one clade (node 3 also holds the Allosaurus-Sinraptor pair), so it is not encoded. Polytomies: node 3 (the Allosaurus pair, the tyrannosaurid pair and node 5) and node 12 (four compsognathids). Replacement for cau2018a_fig6 (seed 20261202). 28 tips, 2 polytomies (3, 4 children); 1 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
